hero.title: A CONTEMPORARY CHRISTIAN CHURCH IN BRATISLAVA

about.title: About us
about.paragraph1: Emmanuel Church in Bratislava is a modern Christian community where people gather around faith in Jesus Christ, prayer and God's Word.
about.paragraph2: We meet every Sunday at 10:00 for church service, worship and meaningful fellowship.
about.paragraph3: It is important to us to be an open community where families, young people and everyone seeking spiritual support can find a home.

vision.title: Church vision
vision.item1Text: We gather to glorify God, pray and listen to His Word.
vision.item2Text: We build open relationships where people can find support and a home.
vision.item3Text: We help everyone grow in faith through learning, prayer and ministry.
vision.item4Text: We serve people in Bratislava with love, attention and practical help.

creed.title: Statement of Faith
creed.intro: Our statement of faith presents the Christian convictions on which the life and ministry of Emmanuel Church are built.

items.title: 1. Jesus Christ
paragraphs: We believe that Jesus Christ is God, Savior and Lord of all creation; He is the perfect revelation of God and the only mediator between God and humanity. He was conceived by the Holy Spirit, born of the Virgin Mary, lived a sinless life, died on the cross for the sins of humanity, rose bodily from the dead, ascended to the Father, and will return again in power and glory.

We believe that God the Son is uncreated and eternally begotten of the Father, of one essence with the Father and possessing all divine attributes. For the salvation of humanity He became incarnate without ceasing to be divine; therefore Jesus Christ is true God and true Man.

items.title: 2. God
paragraphs: We believe in one omnipotent and eternal God who exists as Father, Son and Holy Spirit: three divine persons sharing one divine essence and eternal life. God is holy, all-knowing, everywhere present, Creator and Sustainer of all things, worthy of all worship and glory.
We believe that God the Father is uncreated, eternal, and the source through whom all things exist. He is holy, good, righteous, and the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

We believe that God the Holy Spirit is uncreated, proceeding from the Father through the Son, equal with the Father and the Son, glorifying Christ, convicting of sin, regenerating believers, and leading the Church in truth and sanctification.

items.title: 3. Humanity
paragraphs: We believe that human beings are created in the image and likeness of God for fellowship with Him, worship, stewardship of creation, and holy living. God created humanity with free will and the responsibility to choose between good and evil.

We believe that human beings belong both to the physical (visible) world and the spiritual (invisible) realm. Through sin humanity became spiritually dead, inherited a sinful nature, and became subject to physical death. As a result of the fall, humanity cannot by its own power find God apart from divine grace; therefore, all people need redemption through Jesus Christ.

items.title: 4. Redemption
paragraphs: We believe that God foresaw the fall of humanity and prepared a plan of salvation according to which Christ was the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.

We believe that the cross and resurrection of Jesus Christ provide the only redemption from sin. Christ bore the sins of humanity, satisfied divine justice, and accomplished complete salvation for all who believe.

items.title: 5. Salvation by Grace
paragraphs: We believe that salvation is by God’s grace alone through personal faith in Jesus Christ and not by human works. Through repentance and faith, sinners receive forgiveness, justification, regeneration, adoption into God’s family, and eternal life. Good works are the fruit of the Holy Spirit dwelling in believers and witness of the authentic Christian life.

items.title: 6. Conversion
paragraphs: We believe that authentic Christian life begins with conversion to Christ through repentance and faith. Repentance and conversion include sorrow for committed sin, confession of sin before God, turning away from sin, and accepting Jesus Christ as personal Savior. The Holy Spirit leads people to repentance through the Word of God. Conversion results in new birth from above — the resurrection of a person from spiritual death into new life, rather than the reformation of the sinful human nature — transformed life, and growth in holiness.

items.title: 7. Scripture and Ecumenical Councils
paragraphs: We believe that the sixty-six books of Holy Scripture are inspired by the Holy Spirit and are the supreme, sufficient, and trustworthy authority for Christian faith and life. Jesus Christ is the center and fulfillment of Scripture. We agree with the decisions of the first four ecumenical councils.

items.title: 8. The Church
paragraphs: The Church is the new people of God, the invisible temple of the Lord, and a living spiritual organism whose Head is Jesus Christ.

We believe that the universal Church is the Body of Christ composed of all born-again believers from every nation and generation. The universal Church of Christ is not a continuation of Old Testament Israel, but was established by Jesus Christ on the Day of Pentecost upon the foundation of the apostles and prophets, with Jesus Christ Himself being the chief cornerstone. Belonging to the universal Church does not remove the responsibility of belonging to a local church, the only place believers can fulfill their responsibilities toward brothers and sisters in Christ.

We believe that the local church is a group of Christians who meet regularly in the name of Christ to publicly affirm their faith and to care for one another’s commitment to Jesus Christ and His Kingdom through the preaching of the Gospel, the sacraments and practicing of church discipline.

items.title: 9. The Lord’s Return and Last Things
paragraphs: We believe that Jesus Christ will return again in power and glory, raise the dead, judge all humanity, establish His eternal kingdom, and bring everlasting life to the redeemed and eternal punishment to those who reject Him.
